title: Cue
description: A timed, machine-readable overlay instruction (rule 4.1 stage d). Screens show it at show_at in match time, keep it at least min_dwell_ms, and drop it at expires_at. The cue log is also the edit list for the recap videos.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per session, across all screens.

min_dwell_ms.description: Real milliseconds. The plan uses 6000 on the group screen.

replaces.description: cue_id this one replaces, for a plain stat upgraded to an explanation.

kind.description: stat: plain number card from code. explanation: a manager agent's text. host_reason: why the group screen shows this. table: league table. tag: player name tag on the pitch. summary: a manager's half-time or full-time summary, on their phone. recap_ready: link to the recap video. clash: on a close call, the two competing pitches on the group screen until verdict_at, then the verdict (#89). lost_screen: on a phone, the manager's moment lost the group screen to winner (#89).

body_source.description: On a group explanation card: who wrote its body, the winner's pitch. manager (an agent) or code (#138). The cue's source says who decided the screen, not who wrote the line.

evidence.description: Shown in the analyst evidence drawer.

rulebook.description: League rulebook entries a summary relies on, retrieved from the Foundry IQ knowledge base (#18).

contenders.description: The two pitches the group screen shows on a close call before the verdict (#89). On a clash cue only.

pitch_source.description: Who wrote the pitch: manager (the agent) or code (#138).

verdict_at.description: Match time at which a clash cue switches from the two pitches to the verdict. Not later than expires_at.

winner.description: Whose moment the group screen showed: on a clash cue, the host's pick shown after verdict_at; on a lost_screen cue, the manager who took the screen (never the phone's own manager).
